# Best Treks Nepal

> Best Treks Nepal is a premier Himalayan trekking operator based in Kathmandu, Nepal. We organize authentic, safety-certified trekking packages, high-altitude expeditions, and cultural tours across Nepal's premier trekking regions including Everest, Annapurna, Manaslu, Langtang, Upper Mustang, Dolpo, Kanchenjunga, and Makalu.

## Core Services & Highlights

- **Guided Himalayan Treks**: All-inclusive trekking packages with certified local Sherpa guides, porters, teahouse accommodations, and private ground/heli transportation.
- **Zero-Advance Deposit Policy**: 100% cash-on-arrival payment options in Kathmandu with flexible free date changes.
- **Altitude Safety & Oxygen Protocol**: Daily pulse oximeter monitoring, Gamow bag access, and emergency helicopter evacuation coordination.
- **Sustainable Tourism**: Fair porter wages, eco-conscious trail practices, and Himalayan School sponsorship programs.

## Trekking Regions & Hubs

- [Everest Region](/destinations/everest.html): Home to Mount Everest (8,848.86m), Tengboche Monastery, Gokyo Sacred Lakes, and high alpine passes (Cho La, Kongma La, Renjo La).
- [Annapurna Region](/destinations/annapurna.html): High-altitude circuits, Thorong La Pass (5,416m), Annapurna Sanctuary, Poon Hill sunrise view, and Gurung mountain culture.
- [Manaslu Region](/destinations/manaslu.html): Pristine restricted wilderness circuit around Mt. Manaslu (8,163m), Larkya La Pass (5,106m), and ancient Buddhist Tsum Valley.
- [Langtang Valley](/destinations/langtang.html): Closest mountain sanctuary to Kathmandu, Kyanjin Gompa, Tserko Ri (4,984m), and the 108 sacred alpine lakes of Gosaikunda.
- [Upper Mustang](/destinations/mustang.html): Ancient trans-Himalayan walled kingdom of Lo Manthang, prehistoric cliffside sky caves, and summer rainshadow haven.
- [Upper Dolpo](/destinations/dolpo.html): Shey Phoksundo turquoise alpine lake, nomadic Bon-Po culture, and crystal mountain wilderness.
- [Kanchenjunga](/destinations/kanchenjunga.html): Remote eastern wilderness to the base of the world's 3rd highest peak (8,586m).
- [Makalu Barun](/destinations/makalu.html): Dramatic vertical granite gorges, hanging waterfalls, and untouched pristine biodiversity.

## Top Trekking Packages

- [Everest Base Camp Trek (14 Days)](/treks/everest-base-camp.html): The world-famous classic route from Lukla to EBC (5,364m) and Kala Patthar (5,545m).
- [Annapurna Circuit Trek (14 Days)](/treks/annapurna-circuit.html): Complete traverse across subtropical river gorges up to Thorong La Pass (5,416m).
- [Manaslu Circuit Trek (14 Days)](/treks/manaslu-circuit.html): Restricted pristine wilderness trek crossing Larkya La Pass (5,106m).
- [Langtang Valley Trek (8 Days)](/treks/langtang-valley.html): Scenic valley hike with panoramic views from Kyanjin Ri (4,773m).
- [Upper Mustang Trek (14 Days)](/treks/upper-mustang.html): Trans-Himalayan desert landscapes and 14th-century fortified capital of Lo Manthang.
- [Gokyo Lakes Trek (12 Days)](/treks/gokyo-lakes.html): Pristine glacial lakes and panoramic vista of 4 eight-thousanders from Gokyo Ri (5,357m).
- [Everest Three Passes Trek (19 Days)](/treks/three-passes.html): The ultimate Himalayan challenge crossing Kongma La, Cho La, and Renjo La.
